source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.finding: Text mentions dropout layers at the end of the contracting path; Figure1 has no dropout glyph.
source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.handling: Preserve the entire published diagram and disclose that it is not the complete executed training graph; no invented dropout location/rate.

source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.finding: Output is labelled segmentation map with2channels; explicit pixelwise softmax appears only in text.
source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.handling: Retain2-channel output interface and distinguish it from a hard-label/instance mask; do not invent a drawn softmax or argmax.

source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.finding: Caption says32x32 in lowest resolution while two subsequent deepest-level valid convolutions visibly produce30x30 and28x28.
source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.handling: Report literal sizes;32x32 is the deepest-level entry in this reading, not the global minimum map extent. This interpretation resolves level wording, not an official erratum.

source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.finding: Text says channels double at each downsampling step; the immediate max-pool output retains the prior channel count, followed by a convolution that expands channels.
source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.handling: Do not assign channel doubling to max pooling itself. Preserve displayed map interfaces.

source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.handling: Record as source sign/objective-convention tension; no author-code or correction evidence resolves it here. Do not silently change it or add loss algebra toFigure1.

source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.finding: Corresponding cropping is supported, but exact numeric crop origin/per-side offsets and overlap-tile stitch indices are not stated.
source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.handling: Total size reductions are auditable; centered/per-side crop offsets remain unverified.

source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.finding: Some pooled/up-convolved/repeated map channel labels are not individually printed. Values listed in inventory use adjacent combined labels, copied-map channels and preservation/halving rules.
source_discrepancies_and_unknowns.handling: Those derived interface values are marked; no claim that every count is separately printed.
